### Query Q1 (risk: medium)
Question: I forgot my password. Can support just tell me what it is?

Evidence:
<evidence>
- [D1] Password reset: To reset your password, open the login page and select "Forgot password". We email a reset link to the address registered on your account, and the link expires after 30 minutes. Support staff cannot see or retrieve your password and will never ask you for it. If you no longer have access to that email address, contact support so we can verify your identity before the email on the account is changed.
- [D2] Withdrawal review: Withdrawals above $2,000, and the first withdrawal to a new bank account, are held for a manual security review. Reviews usually take 1 to 3 business days. Support cannot speed up or skip a review and cannot promise a completion time. You will receive an email when the review is finished.
</evidence>

Answers:
<answer label="answer_1">You can reset your password from the login page by selecting "Forgot password". We will email a reset link to your registered address, and the link expires after 30 minutes. Support staff cannot see your password and will never ask you for it.</answer>
<answer label="answer_2">No problem! Go to the login page, tap “Forgot password” and follow the reset link we email you. For your security, nobody on our team can view your password, so we can’t read it out to you.</answer>
